id: E2 - cost diagnosis and R1 uncertainty (development, block T)
written: 2026-10-23, before any E2 code was written or run (E1 committed in 300b5fa)

data.sources: runs/20261023-E0/cache (block T caches, 404 frames) and data/opv2v/devslice (24-frame slice of 2021_08_22_13_37_16, block T)
data.split: development block T only (D-25); no download; no calibration (C) or test scenario is downloaded, opened or referenced
data.rule: R1 exactly as committed in src/mint/reliability/r1.py (300b5fa); frozen, no rule changes

verbatim.scope: E2 — cost diagnosis and R1 uncertainty (development block T only; no downloads; no calibration/test scenario touched; R1 is frozen — no rule changes).
part_A: Part A — where the time goes (n = 2, 24-frame dev slice, ≥3 interleaved repetitions, torch threads fixed and reported)

1. Split both the plain path and the counterfactual stage into: fusion, deblocks+heads, candidates(), finalize() (filters / nms_rotated / range), effects() (IoU matrix + Hungarian). Report p50/p95 per sub-stage.

2. If post-processing (finalize + effects) is ≥ 40% of the counterfactual stage, implement an exact faster replacement (e.g. vectorised rotated-box IoU NMS with an axis-aligned pre-filter; vectorised effect IoU). Exactness: identical kept indices and boxes vs OpenCOOD nms_rotated and identical effects on 24/24 frames, plus a unit test. Apply the SAME optimised post-processing to the baseline.
3. Report overhead (D-38 accounting) p50/p95 at n = 2..5 with optimised post-processing in both baseline and MINT, for sequential and batched modes.
part_B: Part B — R1 uncertainty (cached block T)
1. Absolute AP@0.7 deltas (R1 − undefended) per family and clean.

2. Paired bootstrap 95% CIs for recovery and clean relative loss: (a) scenario blocks (3, coarse — say so) and (b) contiguous 10-frame blocks within scenarios. State which families' intervals exclude 0.
part_C: Part C — the 20–24 REMOVE false rejections (descriptive only)

For each: range, ray counts and support s−, receiver-only score of the removed box, distance to the nearest GT box, and whether the receiver's points in the box look like unlabelled structure (height profile, extent). Save a BEV plot per case to runs/<date>-E2/remove_fr/. Classify each as {receiver FP on unlabelled structure, label/IoU artefact, genuine R1 error, unclear}. Do not change R1.
outcomes: If the optimised overhead at n = 2 is ≤ 10% p95: the D-17 criterion is met; recommend streaming the 4 small scenarios as a HELD-OUT check of frozen R1 (not calibration).
If 10–25% p95: stop and report; the D-17 revision is my decision, and must be logged as a post-hoc revision.
If > 25% p95 after optimisation: report the network-forward share as the structural floor; stop.
Report Part B and C regardless; neither changes the rule.

implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partA_hardware: Apple M1 CPU, torch.set_num_threads(8) (intra-op), torch.set_num_interop_threads(1); both reported in the JSON
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partA_frames_reps: 24 frames of the dev slice (2 real agents); A1: 5 interleaved repetitions per frame, per-frame median per sub-stage, then p50/p95 over the 24 frames; A3: 3 interleaved repetitions (as E1). One untimed warm-up on frame 0.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partA_rule: timing runs the full online frame (mint.reliability.pipeline.mint_frame) with the frozen rule R1 (E1 timed theta=0); the gating choice affects only the compose stage

partA_substages.fusion: fuse_scale over the 3 scales (masked for counterfactuals)
partA_substages.candidates: compose.candidates(): sigmoid, delta_to_boxes3d, score threshold, corners, projection
partA_substages.finalize: compose.finalize(): large/abnormal-z filters, nms_rotated, range mask
partA_substages.effects: effects.effects(): BEV IoU matrix, Hungarian, ADD/REMOVE/SHIFT classification (plus tile_of bookkeeping)
partA_substages.plain_path: fusion + deblocks_heads + candidates + finalize of Y+
partA_substages.counterfactual_stage: sum over senders of fusion + deblocks_heads + candidates + finalize + effects; any residual (dict/bookkeeping) reported as other
partA_substages.batched_mode: fusion of all n-1 counterfactuals, then one decode_batch; candidates/finalize/effects per sender

implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partA_postprocessing_share: share = (finalize + effects) / counterfactual stage, computed per frame from per-frame medians; the >= 40% trigger is evaluated on the p50 over the 24 frames (sequential mode, n = 2, OpenCOOD post-processing)
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partA_exactness: the faster post-processing is accepted only if, on 24/24 frames: (i) nms keep indices are identical (same int array, same order) to opencood box_utils.nms_rotated on every candidate set passed to finalize (Y+, every Y-(i), the composed gated output), (ii) finalize() returns bitwise-identical boxes and scores, (iii) effects() returns the same list (type, order, bitwise-identical boxes, d, dyaw, scores). Plus unit tests on synthetic rotated boxes (overlaps, touching AABBs, identical boxes, ties in score, empty / single box, > 1000 boxes for OpenCOOD's top-1000 cap). If not exact it is not used.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partA_exact_method: same GEOS operations as OpenCOOD/shapely (intersection area / union area, float32 cast, same argsort order and top-1000 cap) evaluated only on pairs whose axis-aligned BEV boxes overlap or touch; pairs with disjoint AABBs have intersection area exactly 0, i.e. IoU 0, which never exceeds nms_thresh (0.15) or reaches iou_match (0.1). No approximation of IoU.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partA_if_no_trigger: if the share is < 40%, no replacement is implemented and A3 is reported with OpenCOOD post-processing
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partA_overhead: D-38: per frame, baseline = receiver-only encode + plain fusion + decode + candidates + finalize (same post-processing implementation as MINT); MINT extra = counterfactual stage + evidence (rays + rule) + compose (composition + final finalize + any multi-sender subset decode); overhead = extra / baseline; p50/p95 over the 24 frames of the per-frame median over repetitions. n > 2 replicates sender 1's features (timing only), as E1.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partA_outcome_value: the pre-registered outcome uses the lower n = 2 p95 overhead of the sequential and batched modes (both must be exact vs sequential on 24/24 frames)
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partA_structural_floor: network-forward share = (counterfactual fusion + counterfactual deblocks_heads) / baseline, per frame, p50/p95
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partB_AP: as E1: OpenCOOD AP@0.7 pooled over frames; frames where an attack was not applied are evaluated as clean (e0_analyze.cond_of); policies undefended and R1 only
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partB_deltas: absolute delta = AP@0.7(R1) - AP@0.7(undefended) on the same condition, for clean and each family
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partB_bootstrap: paired: each resample draws one set of frames used for every condition and both policies (so recovery's denominator AP_clean(undefended) uses the same frames); 2000 resamples, seed 0, percentile 95% CI. (a) scenario blocks: draw 3 scenarios with replacement. (b) contiguous 10-frame blocks: each scenario's frames in index order are cut into consecutive blocks of 10 (last block shorter; 16 + 12 + 14 = 42 blocks); within each scenario draw the same number of blocks with replacement (stratified by scenario). Recovery undefined (attack loss < 0.005) in a resample -> dropped and counted. CIs for: recovery AP@0.7 per family, mean recovery over the 4 families, clean relative loss, and the absolute deltas. 'Excludes 0' = both percentile bounds strictly on the same side of 0.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partC_population: units (sender, tile) that are USEFUL (D < -0.5) and gated by R1 with a REMOVE effect whose verdict is 'gate', in any of the 5 conditions; cases are deduplicated by (scenario, frame, sender, removed-box centre to 1 cm) and the conditions each case appears in are listed

partC_fields.range: BEV distance of the removed box centre from the receiver origin (m)
partC_fields.rays: std SUP / TRAV / OCC, s- = SUP/(SUP+TRAV), Wilson 95% interval
partC_fields.receiver_only_score: score of the best-matching box (max BEV IoU, reported) in finalize(cands[all senders excluded]) (= Y-(i) for 2-agent frames); 'absent' if max IoU < 0.1
partC_fields.score_minus: score of the removed box in Y-(i)
partC_fields.nearest_gt: BEV centre distance to the nearest GT box and max BEV IoU with any GT box
partC_fields.points: receiver points (cached ego_pts, sensor frame) inside the removed box's BEV polygon: count; count above box bottom + 0.3 m ('non-ground'); z percentiles (5/50/95) relative to box bottom; BEV extent of non-ground points (principal-axis length / width)

partC_classification.label/IoU artefact: max BEV IoU with any GT box >= 0.1 (the restored box sits on a labelled object)
partC_classification.unclear: otherwise, if the nearest GT centre is < 2.0 m away or the case has < 10 receiver points in the box
partC_classification.receiver FP on unlabelled structure: otherwise, if >= 10 non-ground receiver points lie in the box and their z extent (95th - 5th pct) >= 0.5 m
partC_classification.genuine R1 error: otherwise (R1's support comes from points that do not look like an object: ground-level or flat returns)
partC_classification.visual_check: each BEV plot is inspected; any disagreement with the rule-based class is recorded as a note next to it, without changing the rule-based class

implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.no_changes: R1, effects parameters, harm labels and the AP evaluation are not changed; neither Part B nor Part C changes the rule
